title: Superfield Component Decompositions and the Scan for Prepotential Supermultiplets in 10D Superspaces
authors: S. James Gates, Jr. | Yangrui Hu | S.-N. Hazel Mak
series_role: Higher-dimensional Adinkra precursor: presents explicit 10D scalar-superfield decompositions and defines Adinkra graphs whose nodes carry SO(1,9) spin-bundle representations.
selection_basis: One of the four papers designated for the original Adynkra sequence in the pilot.

title: Adinkra Foundation of Component Decomposition and the Scan for Superconformal Multiplets in 11D, N = 1 Superspace
authors: S. James Gates, Jr. | Yangrui Hu | S.-N. Hazel Mak
series_role: Adinkra-based 11D component-decomposition foundation and scan for superconformal multiplets.
selection_basis: One of the four papers designated for the original Adynkra sequence in the pilot.

title: Advening to Adynkrafields: Young Tableaux to Component Fields of the 10D, N = 1 Scalar Superfield
authors: S. James Gates, Jr. | Yangrui Hu | S.-N. Hazel Mak
series_role: Introduces Adynkras and Adynkrafields using Dynkin labels, Young tableaux, and component-field index structures.
selection_basis: One of the four papers designated for the original Adynkra sequence in the pilot.

title: Component Decompositions and Adynkra Libraries for Supermultiplets in Lower Dimensional Superspaces
authors: S. James Gates, Jr. | Yangrui Hu | S.-N. Hazel Mak
series_role: Presents Adynkra libraries for component-field embeddings in Salam-Strathdee superfields from dimension nine through dimension four.
selection_basis: One of the four papers designated for the original Adynkra sequence in the pilot.

title: The 300 “Correlators” Suggests 4D, N = 1 SUSY Is a Solution to a Set of Sudoku Puzzles
authors: Aleksander J. Cianciara | S. James Gates, Jr. | Yangrui Hu | Renée Kirk
series_role: Studies the S4 permutahedron with 24 vertices, its six four-permutation subsets, and the four-color formulation of minimal 4D, N = 1 off-shell supersymmetry representations.
selection_basis: Confirmed as the fourth paper in the supplied four-paper set.
curation_note: Confirmed as the fourth paper. Its S4 and 24-vertex subject supplies the smaller permutahedron analysis used by 2012.14015 and 2304.09830.

title: A Note On Exemplary Off-Shell Constructions Of 4D, N = 2 Supersymmetry Representations
authors: Devin D. Bristow | John H. Caporaletti | Aleksander J. Cianciara | S. James Gates, Jr. | Delina Levine | Gabriel Yerger
series_role: Studies S8 permutations and Height Yielding Matrix Numbers for combinations of off-shell 4D, N = 1 multiplets into off-shell 4D, N = 2 multiplets; relates the S4 24-vertex and S8 40,320-vertex permutahedra.
selection_basis: One of the three distinct arXiv papers explicitly linked by Gates.

title: N = 2 SUSY & the Hexipentisteriruncicantitruncated 7-Simplex
authors: Aleksander J. Cianciara | Zachary Coleman | S. James Gates, Jr. | Youngik (Tom) Lee | Ziyang Zhang
series_role: Introduces hopping operators and partitions the 8! vertices of the S8 permutahedron into 5,040 octets; studies higher-order permutahedron faces and lower-order supermultiplets.
selection_basis: One of the three distinct arXiv papers explicitly linked by Gates.

title: Unfolded Adinkra Properties of Supermultiplets (I)
authors: Aleksander J. Cianciara | S. James Gates, Jr. | Youngik (Tom) Lee | Ethan T. Levy | Tarek O. Razzaz | Jacob Richardson
series_role: Introduces infinite unfolded Adinkras, net-centric quantities, and Adinkra vorticity for familiar 4D, N = 1 supermultiplets.
selection_basis: One of the three distinct arXiv papers explicitly linked by Gates.

title: Adynkra Genomes, Adynkrafields, and the 4D, N = 1 Supergravity Superfield Prepotential
authors: S. James Gates, Jr. | Yangrui Hu
series_role: Later continuation applying Adynkra genomes and Adynkrafields to the 4D, N = 1 supergravity superfield prepotential.
selection_basis: Later Adynkra continuation designated for the pilot.
